category_title: Students who demonstrate high engagement and responsiveness to visual schedules
scenario_title: Ball catching activity with visual distractions and high excitement
minimal_context: The student is standing on a spot in the gym practicing catching a ball with two hands.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start our next activity. Please stand on your spot.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets the picture schedule out again to see what's next) Catch.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Yes. Hands out, look at the ball. (Tosses the ball)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Catches with two hands, squeezes the ball, then smiles and jumps up and down because she is really excited)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, let's do another one. Look over here and listen to me.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks away at the visual stimuli in the room, seeing things and not focusing on what the teacher is trying to say)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's start our next activity. Please stand on your spot.

STUDENT: (Gets the picture schedule out again to see what's next) Catch.

TUTOR: Yes. Hands out, look at the ball. (Tosses the ball)

STUDENT: (Catches with two hands, squeezes the ball, then smiles and jumps up and down because she is really excited)

TUTOR: Okay, let's do another one. Look over here and listen to me.

STUDENT: (Looks away at the visual stimuli in the room, seeing things and not focusing on what the teacher is trying to say)

context.environment: APE session, potentially crowded spaces with visual stimuli
context.materials: Ball, spot to stand on, picture schedule

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When exposed to visual stimuli in the environment
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Seeing things and not focusing on what the teacher is trying to say

behavior_patterns.condition: When really excited or after completing a trial

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Gets the picture schedule out again to see what's next
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Does not really like APE, needs to feel more control
